summary: Fixed the silent-wrong-pick on ambiguous bare names. Guarded the fast-path to ALL-UPPERCASE tokens + rewrote _ticker_instr query-driven. DECISION (ran): resolve to the dominant everyday reading (99% intent, best UX); reconfirm only on a genuine tie. Recall floor still 0 violations.
